name: Symbiosis Centre for Management and Human Resource Development

programs.name: Master of Business Administration (MBA)
programs.feeNote: Academic fees for Indian students: Rs 6,45,500 per instalment x 4 = Rs 25,82,000. Excludes refundable institute deposit (Rs 20,000) and hostel deposit (Rs 20,000), hostel (3-sharing, Rs 1,12,500 year 1) and mess (Rs 59,800 per instalment year 1); hostel/mess may rise up to 15% a year. Separate MBA (Business Analytics) and MBA (Infrastructure Development & Management) programmes have different fees.
programs.intakeNote: MBA (Marketing/Finance/HR/Operations) seats per SCMHRD MBA programme page (2026-28/2027-29); reservations SC 15%, ST 7.5%, PwD 3%. MBA-BA (90) and MBA-IDM (60) are separate programmes.
programs.placementNote: Official Final Placement Report batch 2024-26, flagship MBA (HR, Sales & Marketing, Finance) combined: highest Rs 38.00 L, median Rs 20.00 L, average Rs 21.90 L; 114+ recruiters; 50% of offers at Rs 20 L and above. Excludes MBA-BA and MBA-IDM. Not stated as audited.

selectionProcess.name: SNAP 2026 test
selectionProcess.weightage: 50 marks (SNAP score out of 60 scaled to 50)

selectionProcess.name: Personal Interaction (PI)
selectionProcess.detail: Final selection on cumulative performance in SNAP, GE and PI; first merit list 2 Mar 2027.

selectionWeightage.note: Common SNAP 2026 final-merit weightage per official SNAP site; SCMHRD page states cumulative SNAP+GE+PI without numbers.

keyDates.notes: For MBA 2027-29: SNAP registration closes 25 Nov 2026; SNAP tests 13, 19, 26 Dec 2026; result 12 Jan 2027; SCMHRD registration closes 12 Dec 2026; shortlist 21 Jan 2027; GE-PI slot booking 21-24 Jan 2027; GE-PI 30-31 Jan & 2-12 Feb 2027; first merit list 2 Mar 2027; fee deadline 16 Mar 2027; programme starts 3 Jun 2027.

nirf.note: Not in NIRF 2025 Management ranks 1-100; 101-125 band not checked
